description: Search published JPFreeSoft entries by keywords and explicit facts. Exact filters exclude unknown values. Returns source URLs and unconfirmed fields; results are not ranked recommendations. Types: software, ai_tool. Maximum 10 results with offset pagination.

account_needed.description: Match only explicitly recorded account requirement. Unknown values are excluded.

category.description: Exact category slug or label from catalog results.

free_plan.description: Match only explicitly recorded free-plan status. Unknown values are excluded.

japanese_support.description: Exact recorded value, e.g. strong, medium, limited. Unknown values are excluded.

query.description: Keywords, AND matched after NFKC normalization; no semantic recommendation.

name: search_catalog
title: Search Japanese software and AI tools
